subject: Morning Drive — surge pass allocation confirmation
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Liao <tom.liao@cloudbridge.ai>, CloudBridge Events <events@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Morning Drive — promo pass pool request

Hi Tom / CloudBridge team,

Great to meet you on the demo yesterday — thanks again for hosting the Morning Drive slot. As discussed, we want to offer attendees a small trial allotment to encourage follow-ups and product exploration.

Request: can we reserve a surge pool of 300 one-week trial passes (promo codes) to be issued to registrants and attendees over the next two weeks? Suggested split: 250 attendee passes + 30 speaker/referrer passes + 20 ops/reserve.

Attached is a quick spec with proposed code naming, redemption window, and throttling rules (promo_batch_spec.pdf). I also included the expected attendee counts per session (audience_counts_0616.csv).

Operational asks for internal team:
- Marissa: can ops generate the codes and confirm distribution via the post-event email stream?
- Karthik: can you confirm the quantization/limits so the runtime team can pre-warm any required serving capacity for redemptions?
- Tom: let me know if CloudBridge needs a different split or additional partner codes.

Target timeline: finalize allocations by EOD 2026-06-16 so we can include codes in the session follow-up.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Partnerships & Growth
Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_batch_spec.pdf (spec sheet), audience_counts_0616.csv (attendee breakdown)

From: Tom Liao <tom.liao@cloudbridge.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudBridge Events <events@cloudbridge.ai>, Aisha Khan <aisha@eventops.co>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Morning Drive — promo pass pool request

Naomi — thanks for the follow-up and the clear spec. Quick answers from our side:

- 250 attendee passes looks fine. We expect ~220 registrants for the June 18 session, so that gives a small buffer.
- Please reserve 35 speaker/referrer passes instead of 30 — we have three partner speakers that will want individual codes they can hand out.
- 15 ops/reserve is sufficient; we prefer not to hold too many in the back pocket.

One ask: can code names include the session ID (MD-0618) so our analytics team can attribute redemptions to Morning Drive specifically?

If that works, I can sign off and Aisha will coordinate deliverables for the post-event email.

Best,
Tom
Director, Events — CloudBridge

Thanks — looping ops in. Quick ops notes:

- We can generate 300 single-use codes scoped to MD-0618 as requested. Format: REDW-MD0618-XXXX.
- Redemption window: 7 days from issue. We can emit codes in two batches: pre-event (100) and post-event drip (200) to reduce spoilage.
- Delivery: we will hand over a CSV with codes + redemption URL. Marissa (me) will provide the file to CloudBridge for inclusion in the follow-up email.

Ben: I see an internal accounting quirk — partner/referrer codes (the 35) need a different GL tag so we can track partner-sourced conversions separately. Ben, can you confirm the GL tag to apply?

Marissa Cole
Growth Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: promo_batch_spec.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Liao <tom.liao@cloudbridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 13:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Morning Drive — promo pass pool request

Marissa / Naomi — GL tagging confirmed. Use account code PR-MKT-18 for attendee-issued credits and PR-PART-06 for partner/referrer codes. Also flag the 35 partner codes as "partner-credit" in the export CSV so finance can reconcile.

One operational caveat: if we start seeing heavy redemption within the first 48 hours, we should throttle issuance to maintain SLOs. Karthik, please advise whether runtime pre-warm is required for a burst scenario of ~5k token-generating calls from new trials on day 1.

Ben Carter
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Liao <tom.liao@cloudbridge.ai>, Aisha Khan <aisha@eventops.co>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Morning Drive — surge pass allocation confirmation

All — sounds good. Quick notes from the runtime side: 

- Pre-warm: we'll pre-warm inference pools for a short window the morning after the event (24–36 hours). That covers the likely redemption surge. No long-term capacity commit required.
- Throttling: ops can set the promo redemption endpoint to soft-throttle after 600 concurrent redemptions; we will queue and serve to avoid tail-latency spikes.
- Code format MD-0618 embedded in code names is fine.

Naomi — I'm happy to sign off on the plan. Marissa, once you produce the CSV, send to runtime ops (runtime-ops@redwoodinference.com) and I'll confirm the pre-warm window.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Serving Platform
Redwood Inference
